versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is MACHINE-CHECKED (extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json 'version'). counts are MACHINE-CHECKED (recomputed from disk). repositoryVersion is documentation-only (hand-maintained, nothing checks it). pageSpecVersion is enforced for instances by the schema (pageSpecVersion const '2.0.0'); this manifest field itself is hand-maintained.

source.kind: clone of a real, live company marketing site
source.cloneStack: React 18.3 + Vite 5.4 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 (original: Next.js + Tailwind v4)
source.relation: built from the sibling project folder that contains this design-repo; citations in extraction/measured-values.json

contentPolicy: Design system only. No source marketing copy, legal text, Ukrainian strings, screenshots, animations (.lottie), logos/brand marks or font files are included. Section examples and the reference example use generic placeholder copy; the generated examples use a fictional brand. Exceptions, both deliberate: assets/source-copy-hashes.json stores only SHA-256 prefixes of source copy / CTA strings / media file stems, and schema/tests/adversarial_test.py carries a few short source strings (marked SOURCE) used only to prove rejection. assets/asset-roles.json -> sourceBrand lists the source's brand, domains, endpoint and named people/companies as readable patterns so they can be reviewed.

modes.reference: faithful reconstruction of the source (real brand, copy and reference-only asset roles accepted as evidence)
modes.generated: a new page for another brand; GENERATED_MODE_* rules reject any source identity or content (string-based detection, see README)
